title: Dispersive and Strichartz Estimates for the Schrödinger Equation Inside Cylindrical Domains
summary: Dispersive and Strichartz estimates are fundamental tools for establishing the well-posedness and long-time behavior of solutions to nonlinear partial differential equations. While these estimates are well-understood in the boundaryless Euclidean setting, the presence of a geometric boundary introduces severe analytical complexities, such as the continuous formation of caustics.
